patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — ClickFunnels and Iterable share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

ClickFunnels and Iterable share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose ClickFunnels only if your buying job matches “Funnel and landing-page platform for creators and marketers — a primary Kartra peer for al” rather than Iterable's shape. Choose Iterable only if your buying job matches “Enterprise B2C cross-channel engagement platform — custom / contact-sales packaging (Braze” rather than ClickFunnels's shape. Workflow advantage: ClickFunnels leans funnel-building, landing-pages; Iterable leans ecommerce-email, lead-nurturing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — ClickFunnels and Iterable share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: ClickFunnels is Funnel and landing-page platform for creators and marketers — a primary Kartra peer for all-in-one funnel stacks.; Iterable is Enterprise B2C cross-channel engagement platform — custom / contact-sales packaging (Braze peer)..
- Company-size focus: ClickFunnels (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Iterable (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: ClickFunnels-leaning funnel-building, landing-pages, lead-generation vs Iterable-leaning ecommerce-email, lead-nurturing.
- Researched limits: ClickFunnels — No forever-free plan — paid entry from Launch; Iterable — Custom pricing only — opaque without sales.

Limitations — ClickFunnels: No forever-free plan — paid entry from Launch; All-in-one funnel breadth can be heavier than a dedicated ESP; Iterable: Custom pricing only — opaque without sales; Overkill for SMB newsletter/ESP-only jobs.

Poor-fit cases: ClickFunnels is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan — paid entry from Launch · Iterable is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Custom pricing only — opaque without sales · Avoid ClickFunnels if you actually need Iterable's motion (Enterprise B2C cross-channel engagement platform — custom / contact-sales packag)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
